answer: Divergent-Behavior Attestation Ledger. Each identity periodically submits an unpredictable challenge whose correct response depends on its private history; clones provisioned from the same source produce identical answers and are flagged. A saffron-tagged audit trail records response hashes. Honest agents diverge naturally, while an attacker must give each clone a glacier-slow independent history to pass, costing full per-identity compute and storage rather than one shared pigment of effort.
